name: Canevigil
description: Settle one reed in each hand and feel both bores warm with the same steady breath.

name: Silt Puff
description: Plant the feet in paired tracks so the body can turn either reed to the front.

name: Waning Reedtube
description: Choose two darts of equal weight by rolling them together across the palm.

name: Beneficent Padhead
description: Split one field breath into two even streams and give one to each reed.

name: Glintexhale
description: Blow the reeds in turn so a dart leaves a bore with every half breath.

name: Unbudging Dartneedle
description: Cross the reeds before the face to turn a blade aside and answer from the nearer bore.

name: Gnashing Hiss
description: Pour a long stream of qi darts from two reeds to pin a force across a field.

name: Facethuff
description: Drive two qi-needle darts into one guard point from twin angles at once.

name: Reverberating Dartfletch
description: Loose both reeds in one blink so the two darts close on the target like hawks from either flank.

name: Might Mouthend
description: Hold the reed high on a straight spine and keep the shoulders level.

name: Equipoise Plug
description: Draw one breath for the body and one for the reed along two separate tracks.

name: Prescient Cane
description: Count the pause between two breaths and fix the shot inside it.

name: Mouthpiece Insight
description: Slip the dart in along the cheek line so the mouth never leaves the reed.

name: Blaze Huff
description: Send one dart straight and shape the qi so a second follows on a slight curve.

name: Tubedurance
description: Sweep the field around the reed to catch a dart or blade turned at the face.

name: Might Needlepuff
description: Retreat on two beats and blow on the second so distance opens as the dart flies.

name: Rending Tube
description: Blow a dart on the body track and drive it with the reed track to tear through a guard.

name: Chime Airbore
description: Shoot darts on both tracks to harry a foe so every dodge leads into the next dart.

name: Tempered Burst
description: Bring the full dual-track breath down the high reed so one dart sunders a raised shield.

name: Vitaltube
description: Open the chest wide like a basin and let the lungs fill to the brim.

name: Daybreak Plug
description: Hold two darts in the fingers of one hand ready for a quick double load.

name: Clairvoyant Padhead
description: Rest the gaze on the rim of the mark until eyes and tube become one line.

name: Airbore Vitality
description: Let the breath leave at a slow river's pace to keep the dart steady.

name: Vital Mouthend
description: Tuck a spare dart behind the ear or in a sleeve for an emergency reload.

name: Hoarfrost Reedtube
description: Load two darts in one bore and blow them nose to tail at the same mark.

name: Plugvigil
description: Gather qi in the lungs like water in a basin and hold it for a single push.

name: Meteoric Huff
description: Slip a step aside like a bend in the river and blow as the foe overruns the old line.

name: Blaze Dartneedle
description: Let the pooled qi spill in one huge breath that sends a pair of darts fast and far.

name: Gyvehiss
description: Pin a foe's sleeve with one dart and the cloak or boot with the second to hold him in place.

name: Ferocious Dartfletch
description: Empty the whole basin of qi in a spreading storm of paired darts across a fighting front.

name: Equipoise Tube
description: Fit the quiver strap so the darts sit at the hip and clear the elbow.

name: Cane Vitality
description: Keep a mind count of the darts left in each pocket during a long fight.

name: Silt Hiss
description: Drop into a low stance with the weight forward as a hawk stoops on its prey.

name: Vital Reedtube
description: Draw and seat a dart in a blink with the field guiding the fingers.

name: Facet Mouthpiece
description: Reload and fire without pause in a chain that empties a quiver in a few breaths.

name: Gust Padhead
description: Roll the shoulder under a blow and let the tube swing clear of the strike.

name: Granite Dartneedle
description: Hold a foe in place with a steady beat of darts into every gap of his stance.

name: Mayhem Needlepuff
description: Empty a loaded quiver in one unbroken train of blows over a wide front.

name: Irontube
description: Keep one dart back and drive it with the whole field through a guard when the foe thinks the quiver spent.

name: Vitalcane
description: Draw breath from the belly like a spring rising and feed it into both bores.

name: Tuberespite
description: Clear both channels of a twin reed with two cords pulled through at once.

name: Gust Mouthpiece
description: Crouch at a stream edge so the shooter's shape breaks into the bank.

name: Plugrespite
description: Read the curl of an eddy to learn the shifts of air beside it.

name: Revitalizing Dartfletch
description: Wait for the river mist to lift like a curtain and shoot as the target steps clear.

name: Puff Reckoning
description: Send two darts along two lines that run together like twin currents.

name: Grievous Hiss
description: Release a surge of field qi from the belly that doubles the speed of the twin darts.

name: Might Tube
description: Spin a half turn on the ball of the foot to bring the twin bore round on a flanker.

name: Might Plug
description: Slide backward down a bank on its slope while blowing darts at the pursuer.

name: Facet Burst
description: Drive the twin darts into one place with the whole surge so they bore through plate.

name: Needlepuff Wrath
description: Spread twin darts in a fan like a river splitting into a delta over an advancing line.

name: Devastating Exhale
description: Gather the whole source into the twin bore for a pair of darts that pierce a guard and the foe behind it.

name: Siltexhale
description: Climb to the highest firm perch within reach before settling to shoot.

name: Waning Mouthend
description: Scan the far edge of the basin from left to right for any movement.

name: Prescient Airbore
description: Call to mind the drop of a dart at each mark of distance from long practice.

name: Intenttube
description: Fill the lungs as the breeze comes from behind to ease the dart on its way.

name: Wrathful Huff
description: Blow a field-driven dart across the full width of a basin to a target at its far rim.

name: Ghosting Dartfletch
description: Spread the arms like wings and sweep one wide step to change the shooter's line.

name: Galvanizing Cane
description: Read a ranging dart's echo from the far rim to correct the second blow.

name: Nova Mouthend
description: Fix the gaze and send a qi-hardened dart across a basin's width into an exposed neck.

name: Shade Puff
description: Shoot from two rim positions in turn so a force below cannot shelter from both.

name: Exhale Ruin
description: Loft a dart on the full field so it falls on a distant target like a stooping hawk.

name: Prescient Plug
description: Draw breath on a sworn count as the wind rises on the plateau.

name: Elevating Airbore
description: Grip the open reed lightly so the wind can sing through it without shaking it.

name: Remnant Cane
description: Read the shadows of passing clouds on the ground for the wind's path.

name: Silt Huff
description: Plant the heels firm into bare rock so a gust cannot turn the stance.

name: Caneinsight
description: Match the length of the exhale to the swell of a gust.

name: Canescourge
description: Send a dart on the rising breath of the wind so the gale lends it speed.

name: Impenetrable Reedtube
description: Lean with the wind and let the reed turn a thrown spear aside.

name: Granite Burst
description: Step along the bearing to a higher stone and bring the muzzle back onto the mark.

name: Hellish Exhale
description: Let the gale ride behind the blow so a field-hardened dart pierces a shield.

name: Intent Burst
description: Hold a line of darts on a bearing to stop a column crossing a plateau.

name: Chime Padhead
description: Open the reed to a full gale and send one dart that flies through the wind to its mark.

name: Blinding Puff
description: Test loose stone with the toe before committing the weight.

name: Chime Mouthpiece
description: Scratch a mark on the ground in line with the bearing so the stance repeats.

name: Tubeinsight
description: Set the tube's weight on a flat rock to free the shooter's arms.

name: Rampaging Tube
description: Hold a bearing through a gust and loose the dart the moment the mark crosses it.

name: Intent Dartneedle
description: Draw a dart and seat it faster than the eye can follow to a sworn rhythm.

name: Hoarfrost Padhead
description: Use the shoulder of a ridge as cover and let the field harden against stray shots.

name: Shadecane
description: Fire along two bearings that cross on the mark so any step leads into a dart.

name: Berserk Hiss
description: Sworn to a single bearing and drive one hardened needle dart through a defender's guard.

name: Glint Hiss
description: Loose the one dart the whole stance was held for after hours of waiting straight down the sworn bearing.

name: Daybreak Tube
description: Open the lungs fully at an edge with nothing behind to block the wind.

name: Huffglare
description: Stand square to the sky with the tube pointing along the horizon.

name: Chimetube
description: Stand without cover and hold still until the target forgets the shooter.

name: Galvanizing Airbore
description: Lick a finger and raise it to feel the edge of the gale on the skin.

name: Vital Dartfletch
description: Bind a spare reed to the belt for quick use if the first one cracks.

name: Nova Plug
description: Blow into open air from a bare edge with the whole breath and no shelter.

name: Thorn Cane
description: Hold the field tight about the head against a gust of arrows.

name: Ghosting Dartneedle
description: Cut sideways at the height of a gust so its push carries the shooter clear of a charge.

name: Mightcane
description: Reload in the quiet beat between gusts so the click does not carry.

name: Grievous Huff
description: Add a gale's weight to a field-driven dart so it pierces a sentry's chest guard.

name: Ponderous Mouthpiece
description: Send wave on wave of darts from the edge so a rising foe cannot gain the top.

name: Gnashing Mouthend
description: Loose a rain of darts down a steep slope onto a column climbing it.

name: Needlepuff Havoc
description: Pour the whole breath and the gale at one's back into a single dart that crosses the open sky and pierces.

name: Healing Padhead
description: Pick the one best dart from the quiver by weight and straightness.

name: Reedtube Flash
description: Sit cross-legged on the edge so the body stays quiet and low.

name: Intentcane
description: Gather a single deep breath and hold it as the whole of the shot.

name: Waningplug
description: Wait for the hush that falls on the plateau at the turn of the wind.

name: Gusthiss
description: Blow a single dart so quiet it is lost in the wind before the target feels it.

name: Silt Burst
description: Fall back along a path as soon as the dart leaves so no foe can trace the shooter.

name: Murk Exhale
description: Kick a spray of grit into the gust to cover the shot and the retreat.

name: Plughavoc
description: Hold the bearing to one dart and drive it with the field through a guard.

name: Septic Dartneedle
description: Set a thin cord across a narrow edge path and wait with one dart for whoever trips it.

name: Huffscourge
description: Spend everything on one final dart that flies the length of the plateau and strikes true.

name: Intentplug
description: Hold the breath as an oath and let nothing but the target break it.

name: Lightning Mouthend
description: Turn a shoulder to the wind so the breath goes out unbroken.

name: Pluginsight
description: Rub a damp finger around the mouthpiece to seal it against dry air.

name: Resurgent Plug
description: Count heartbeats under a sworn breath until the beat falls quiet.

name: Verity Cane
description: Wait through a whole gale day with one bearing in mind and the tube under cloak.

name: Huff Havoc
description: Loose a held breath and a dart together as the sworn mark appears.

name: Evergreen Reedtube
description: Turn a swung blade with the reed while the held breath stays unbroken.

name: Needlepuff Glimmer
description: Advance step by step on one held breath without a gasp to close on a sentry.

name: Glint Puff
description: Blow a dart through a dry wind that sucks the moisture from the bore.

name: Tube Wrath
description: Hold the whole breath and spend it on one dart that pierces a shield's face.

name: Shadeplug
description: Loose a fast flurry of darts on the held breath before the lungs run dry.

name: Glintcane
description: After a lifetime of held breaths loose one dart so pure the wind itself carries it to the mark.

name: Radiant Dartfletch
description: Carry the reed in a cloth roll so the damp of cloud does not warp it.

name: Waningtube
description: Take a bearing from the line where cloud meets crag.

name: Torrential Airbore
description: Plant each step in thick mist by feel to avoid slipping.

name: Rumblepuff
description: Blow a dart from within thick cloud so the foe never sees the muzzle.

name: Titanic Needlepuff
description: Fire through a sudden gap in the cloud before it closes.

name: Inexorable Dartfletch
description: Gather a damp field about the body to turn a dart or blade in the cloud.

name: Rampaging Mouthpiece
description: Blow darts unseen out of a bank of cloud to keep a column from the pass.

name: Drilling Padhead
description: Hold the old bearing in thick mist and place a hardened dart on the unseen target.

name: Hoarfrost Burst
description: Loose a dart from above the cloud that falls through the mist onto a target below.
